title: BioF3 Built-in Plugin Manifest
description: Per-platform artifact schema for BioF3 Runtime and plugin distribution. Each plugin declares per-platform artifacts (url/sha256/sizeBytes). sha256 and sizeBytes may be null and filled by CI in Week 4 — but url MUST match the platformId it sits under.

version.description: Manifest format version (semver-ish, e.g. '2.0.0'). Bumped when the schema itself changes.

updated.description: ISO date the manifest was last edited

Artifact.description: Per-platform download artifact. sha256/sizeBytes may be null pre-Week-4; url MUST match the platformId key it lives under.

url.description: HTTPS URL to the artifact zip/tar. Must be hosted on a host in ALLOWED_RUNTIME_HOSTS. Null only for built-in://... pseudo-URLs.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 (64 chars). Null allowed pre-Week-4 — Week 4 fill-in from CI artifact.

sizeBytes.description: Downloaded archive size in bytes (integer >= 0). Null allowed pre-Week-4.

id.description: Plugin id; kebab-case, must match the key under manifest.plugins

kind.description: Top-level kind; 'runtime' for R/Python Runtime, 'plugin' for everything else (FigCode cards/data, content plugins, etc.)

type.description: Subtype preserved for code paths (installRuntime / installFigcodePack / installContentPlugin). Legacy field, keep in sync with kind.

artifacts.description: Per-platform artifact map. Each key MUST be a PlatformId, and the value's url host MUST match the key (no platform mismatch).

checksumAlgorithm.description: Algorithm used for all artifact checksums. Always sha256 for Week 2.

allOf.description: kind=runtime must declare language in {r, python}
Artifact url host must match the platformId key (e.g. artifacts['macos-arm64'].url must end with macos-arm64)

then.description: url pattern is checked by code (selectArtifact), schema only checks url is a string
